In Spain, any vessel under 15 metres can be chartered with a licensed skipper, meaning you don't need a single qualification to enjoy the Costa del Sol from the water. Our no license boat rental prices in Marbella start at €749 for 2 hours on a 12.5m Astondoa 40, and every charter includes a professional skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. No hidden extras, no paperwork – just show up and sail.

Why No License Boat Rental in Marbella Works

Marbella's coastline is ideal for no-license charters because the waters are calm, the marinas are well-equipped, and the weather is reliable. From Puerto Banús, you can cruise west to Cabopino or east to Cala Cortés within 30 minutes. The skipper handles all navigation, so you can focus on sunbathing, swimming, and sipping cava. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are perfect for small groups – they're nimble, comfortable, and meet the no-license threshold at 12.5m.

What's Included in the Price – No Surprises

Every no-license charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper (fluent in English and Spanish)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment (life jackets, first aid)
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

There are no docking fees, cleaning fees, or hidden charges. The price you see is the price you pay. You can bring your own food and extra drinks if you like.

Which Boats Can I Rent Without a License?

All our boats come with a skipper, so any boat in our fleet is available without a license. However, the most popular no-license options are the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 because they offer the best value at €749/2h. If you want a larger experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m) includes a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for 4 hours. For other boats like the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge, pricing is on request.

How to Book Your No License Boat Rental in Marbella

Booking is simple. Visit our Marbella boat rental page, choose your boat and duration, then send us a WhatsApp message. We'll confirm availability and send you a secure payment link. Payment is required to secure the booking. Cancellations made 48+ hours before departure receive a full refund. Same-day bookings are possible if the boat is available.
